useful_scope: Expert multidisciplinary reasoning and expert-knowledge problem solving represented by HLE-Diamond, both closed-book and with web+code tools.

target_reference.evaluator: Center for AI Safety + Scale AI

evidence_reconciliation.newer_benchmark_owner_evidence: HLE-Diamond was released September 22, 2026 after a year-long cleanup/refinement process and evaluates 1,000 questions split into reasoning and knowledge.
evidence_reconciliation.older_conflicting_evidence: Anthropic's earlier/full HLE-with-tools table reported Opus 5.5 67.7 vs GPT-6 Astra 57.2 under a different HLE setting.
evidence_reconciliation.rule: Do not claim the different older HLE setting itself is beaten. Promote the current refined HLE-Diamond capability at its exact scope because the benchmark owner evaluates both systems under the same methodology and Astra exceeds Opus in both no-tool and web+code modes.

claim_limits: This package obsoletes Opus 5.5 for the current HLE-Diamond expert multidisciplinary reasoning/knowledge scope. It does not assert superiority on every historical HLE variant or every possible reasoning task.

ownership_revocation.reason: The operative target capability was still located inside GPT-6 Astra's opaque hidden cognition. Saving a provider/model route is external capability access, not Brain ownership.
ownership_revocation.retained_value: Benchmark evidence proves an equal-or-better capability specimen exists and is useful for discovering/extracting an already-existing reusable capability configuration.

superseded_external_route.knowledge_policy: External/JIT. Retrieve current/domain knowledge at task time; do not store it as the capability.
superseded_external_route.reasoning_policy: Use Astra as configured cognition; preserve task objective, tool plan, verification evidence, and decision receipt in Brain.
superseded_external_route.verification_policy: For consequential answers, independently verify exact computation and material factual claims when feasible; fail closed on unresolved contradictions.
superseded_external_route.cost_policy: Use included Plus Work/Codex allowance only. Do not buy credits or invoke paid API under the current hard-zero incremental-spend constraint.
superseded_external_route.access_preflight: Before execution, verify GPT-6 Astra and required tool surfaces are currently available in the included account allowance.
